method: Batch 93 (mobrec93): the batch 92 b92mr harness with squid (s), bat (b), wither skeleton (k) and wither (w) types; the squid row flags are [pitch, prevPitch, yaw, prevYaw, rotation, tentacle, prevTentacle, motionSpeed, rotationVelocity, rotateSpeed, vector x y z, air], the bat row flags are [hanging, spawnPosition].Unchanged classes on the VillageLiveProbe double (no village), the player a real EntityPlayerMP (ServerPlayerProbe), every mob ticked by Entity.onUpdate. Per tick: [mob rows [x,y,z,health,target index,revenge index,flags,draws], sounds, player health lost, player revenge index, player ticks]; the player has index types.length. See EndermanWolfProbe.java for types and script ops.
